name: PR detail Files changed tab renders the seeded diff
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the unified-diff viewer renders a seeded file path (src/config.ts), that the Smart Diff grouping (Smart order / Original order toggle, role group headers like Core) renders, and that toggling to Original order keeps the seeded file visible. Exercises the refactored diff-viewer (DiffViewer → FileCard → CodeLine) plus the Smart Diff toolbar and groups. Read-only seeded data (no model call, no write actions). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
switch to the Files changed tab
diff tab is active in the URL
a seeded changed file renders in the diff viewer
the Smart order / Original order toggle renders
the Core role group header renders (Smart Diff default order)
the seeded file is still visible grouped by role
switch to Original order (read-only UI toggle)
the seeded file is still visible in Original order
